strict_main_gate_reductions: One strict local-projective reduction: the unrestricted geometric-period quadratic PGL count now holds for arbitrary fixed complete excellent normal local surfaces via projective SNC resolution, including graph cycles and secondary residues. Fixed slicing and finite normalization extend it to complete equicharacteristic local punctures in all dimensions, including nonnormal/nonreduced rings when every component has dimension at least two. This enlarges the same post-review14 tree reduction, rather than adding another movement.

One strict crown-gate enlargement after review14: the coherent full coefficient-gerbe extension and single-sector compression give q^(A_R t r²) projective semilinear counts with unrestricted tame field-image order, and therefore the stated faithful projective automorphism crowns have uniform multiplicity and generator bounds with only the graph quotient bounded. The bounded-index normal-subgroup refinement and fully checked classical/exceptional recognition now include all defining-characteristic finite simple Lie families (with fixed small derived exceptions absorbed), within the same one-curve radially tame outer-quotient scope.
remaining_strongest_gates: Alternating simple-quotient multiplicities and the remaining simple families outside the proved linear/order and bounded-scalar/order criteria.

Unbounded geometric Brauer period in defining-characteristic projective representations on the residual global proper surfaces. The corresponding fixed-complete-local puncture problem is now proved in every dimension with every component dimension at least two. Uniform constants linear in the degree of arbitrary finite local covers remain unproved.
Uncovered cross-characteristic Lie families with order divisible by the ground characteristic.

General monolithic nonabelian crowns outside the proved radially tame one-smooth-exceptional-curve faithful-linear and faithful-projective families. The projective family allows unrestricted diagonal and field-image actions; it suffices that a bounded-index normal subgroup containing the simple socle embeds in PΓL with the stated order comparison. No ambient action of the entire outer group is required. Wild radial permutation quotients, other realizations and other geometries remain unresolved. All named defining-characteristic finite simple Lie families, classical and exceptional including Suzuki/Ree, are now verified in this same one-curve radially tame crown scope.
Full finite generation for the residual nonprojective normal proper surface punctures and original-boundary tame quotients.
Higher-dimensional boundary reductions outside finite omitted loci, controlled exceptional centres and the proved projective-model full-generation criteria; nonnormal D2 scope retained.
auxiliary_not_movement: The tree geometry, arbitrary-SNC geometry and effective atlas, actual unit-Isom comparison, SNC resolution, fixed slicing, and finite-normalization transfers are dependencies or closures of this single local-projective reduction, not separate movements.
All ordinary hereditary PGL and bounded-field crown results already included in review14 remain accounted there and cannot be counted again.
Searches, audit refreshes, compilation, image inspection and checkpoint assembly are not research movement.

The coherent-gerbe, single-sector and skew-unit statements, and the completed bounded-index normal-subgroup refinement, belong to the same unbounded-field crown enlargement. Their assembly and later named-family recognition are not separate movements.

The symmetric-square wild cyclic cover is an alternative all-genus construction of an already known failure of automatic radial tameness. Its exact wild-image order2, generator bound2g+2, and9350-assertion local certificate are auxiliary, not another main-gate reduction.
